_about: Words for the report's 'Not proven, and what it costs' and 'Decided at gate A' blocks (report_facts.py). Closed variety lives here, never in code (FR-13). The keys of `impact` are the impact classes of the plan's own scale (grammar.IMPACT_SCALE); a project can bring a class this table does not hold, and code then quotes the class as written instead of deciding what it means.

impact.data-loss: data can be lost or corrupted in production
impact.money: money can be charged, paid or counted wrongly in production
impact.access: someone can reach what they must not, or be locked out of what they need
impact.blocked-flow: people can be stopped from finishing a flow they rely on
impact.degraded: a flow keeps working, but worse than intended
impact.cosmetic: how it looks or reads is off; the behaviour holds
impact.none: the plan assessed no user impact for it

impact_unknown_words: the plan row names the impact class "{impact}", which this report has no words for
no_impact_words: not assessed at planning: the plan row {ts} records no impact class
no_plan_row_words: not assessed at planning — no plan row

project_wide_checks.s5_environment: a project-wide check of the stand's credentials and accounts; it binds no requirement and no case
project_wide_checks.s5_integrations: a project-wide check of an integration's keys when no case could be tied to it; it binds no requirement and no case

delivery_state_words._about: Words for the delivery summary (delivery_summary.py render), the text a merge request description carries: the codes of the checks' own records never reach a person (HF8-20, FR-13). `columns` heads the counts table; `row_states` holds the exact states the factory writes, `row_prefixes` the first word of a state (the part before the first colon) for the states that carry prose after it (`prefix_drops_reason` names the prefixes whose part after the colon is a code, never printed; `waived:<state>` is read through the same table, its inner state in words); `bug_states` is the state of a bug's filing; `source_gaps` maps a fragment of a limit the projection recorded to its words. A state or limit not found here is said as `unknown_state` / `unknown_limit` and the code is NOT printed; the render adds the one line `unknown_finding` to the limits block.

row_states.not_verified:stale_ledger_inputs: was verified before, but what it rested on has changed since; it counts as not verified until the results are read again
row_states.not_verified:delivery projection not ava: no verification result is available for it yet
row_states.not_verified:expectation_unconfirmed: waits for your answer about what is expected
row_states.not_verified:missing_sensitivity_proof: its test passed, but nobody has shown that the check can fail
row_states.not_verified:on_substitute: passed only against a stand-in for part of the product; run it again where that part is real
row_states.not_verified:sides_unknown: passed while the record of which parts of the product were real could not be read; run it again
row_states.not_verified:placeholder_open: its test still points at an element the product does not have yet; it proves nothing until the test is run against the real element
row_states.not_executed:blocked_by_check: stands behind a check that failed, so it was not reached
row_states.not_executed:contradicts_requirement: reported as disagreeing with the requirement; no test was run to show it
row_states.not_executed:unresolved: was not run: something it needs is still unresolved
row_states.pending_implementation: waits for the product to implement it
row_states.impossible: the factory found no way to check it

row_prefixes.not_verified_flaky: unstable: it passed and failed on different runs
row_prefixes.impossible: the factory found no way to check it
row_prefixes.review_rejected: the code review rejected its test
row_prefixes.review_unverified: the code review could not confirm its test
row_prefixes.error: the run ended in an error

bug_states.prepared: prepared, not sent to the tracker yet
bug_states.outcome_unknown: sent, but the tracker's answer was not recorded
bug_states.filed: filed as a bug file in the repository, not in the tracker
bug_states.selected: chosen at gate B, not filed yet
bug_states.draft: a draft, not chosen so far
bug_states.provenance_invalid: its link to a gate B decision could not be established, so it is not counted

source_gaps.words: the checks' results are missing, so the outcomes below are the plan's own
the checks' results carry no mark of when they were taken, so they may be out of date
the plan, the run results or the review verdicts changed after the checks' results were written, so those results may be out of date
neither the plan nor the checks' results could be read, so no row is listed

source_gaps.match: verification-gaps.json gaps is not an array
source_gaps.words: the list of open verification gaps could not be read
one open verification gap is recorded in a form the factory cannot read, so it is not listed
a closed verification gap names no evidence for its closing, so it is not counted as closed
the run's results are missing, so the number of checks run is not known

source_gaps.match: the readable text of a bug draft could not be written
source_gaps.words: the readable text of one bug draft could not be written, so the draft is shown without it
one reason for the delivery word is recorded in a form the factory cannot read, so it is not listed

delivery_state_words.unknown_state: the factory cannot say what this row's state means
delivery_state_words.unknown_limit: the factory cannot say what limits this summary
delivery_state_words.unknown_finding: The factory has no words for part of this summary; that is its own gap, and nothing is asked of you.
